jobs.title: Data AI Engineer
jobs.description:
* Experience building or operating an API gateway, reverse proxy or multi-tenant platform.

* LLM platform engineering specifics: streaming and server-sent events, token accounting, prompt and response guardrails, model evaluation.

* Kafka and Snowflake for audit and consumption data pipelines.

* Observability depth: Prometheus and PromQL, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry.

* Redis or Valkey beyond basic caching — counters, TTLs, distributed rate-limiter semantics.

* Experience delivering in a regulated enterprise environment with corporate proxies, private networking and strict change control.

Pay: $55.00 - $60.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Experience:

* Data Engineer: 10 years (Required)
* AI: 2 years (Required)
* Kafka: 10 years (Required)
* OpenTelemetry: 6 years (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60616
